name: Cyrodiil
culture_summary: The cosmopolitan heartland of the Empire. Worship of the Nine Divines grounds society, while the Imperial City serves as the nexus of Tamrielic governance and trade.

name: Skyrim
culture_summary: A harsh northern realm shaped by ancient traditions and martial prowess. Nords venerate Talos and the old pantheon, remaining fiercely independent despite imperial integration.

name: Morrowind
culture_summary: An alien land ruled by the godlike Tribunal and powerful Great Houses. Daedric worship persists among the Ashlanders while House politics dictate everyday life.

name: Black Marsh
culture_summary: An impenetrable swampland connected by the collective consciousness of the Hist. The environment remains hostile to outsiders, keeping the province largely unconquered.

name: Elsweyr
culture_summary: A divided region of deserts and jungles united under the Mane. Moonsugar trade and lunar phases dictate social structures and physical forms of the populace.

name: Valenwood
culture_summary: A dense forest domain strictly governed by the Green Pact. The inhabitants shape living trees into cities and consume only meat to honor their ancient covenant.

name: Summerset Isle
culture_summary: An idyllic archipelago dedicated to magical mastery and ancestral perfection. Society operates on rigid hierarchies honoring Auri-El and the ancient Aldmeri ancestors.

name: Hammerfell
culture_summary: A rugged desert province defined by martial honor and seafaring skill. The Crowns and Forebears maintain a tense political balance while honoring ancient Yokudan traditions.

name: High Rock
culture_summary: A fractured land of competing kingdoms and political intrigue. Knightly orders and magical academies flourish amid constant regional conflicts and alliances.
